speaker: Damián
cn: （喘粗气）干什么？你们家的装修钱都是我出的，活也都是我干的。你们要么还钱，要么我全部砸掉！
en: (gasping) What are you talking about? I paid for all the renovation, and I handled all the work myself. Either you pay me back, or I'm going to tear everything down right here!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （埋怨）Damián，你要干什么？赶紧给我爸道歉，再重新修一下我们家的围墙！
en: (complaining) What are you doing? Go apologize to my dad right away, and fix our fence again!

speaker: Eloísa
en: (terrified) Ah!

speaker: Damián
cn: （大声）Eloísa，这就是你逃婚出轨的代价！
en: (loudly) Eloísa, this is what you get for leaving me at the altar and cheating on me!

speaker: Eloísa
en: (Screams) Ah! My fence!

speaker: Eloísa
en: (grinding her teeth) Damián! You’re dead!

speaker: Damián
cn: 大家都看到了，是她先动手要打我的！
en: Everyone can see—she's the one who tried to hit me!

speaker: Eloísa
en: (tearing up, feeling aggrieved) Damián, do you have to be so heartless?

speaker: Damián
cn: （冷笑）我绝情？Eloísa，我本不想理你，要不是你一次次挑衅，我都不记得装修这回事。我还要谢谢你呢！
en: (snarling) I’m heartless? Eloísa, I had no intention of bothering with you. But you just had to keep provoking me. I’d almost forgotten I paid for that renovation. So thanks for reminding me!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （哀求）别砸了！我求求你别砸了！
en: (pleading) Stop! Please! I beg you, don't smash it!

speaker: Damián
cn: 行啊，把我给你家出的装修钱还给我，三十万美元。
en: Alright, give me back the money I paid for this renovation. 300,000 dollars in total.

speaker: Eloísa
en: (Shocked) 300,000 dollars? Are you crazy?

speaker: Damián
en: (snorts coldly) No? Then I'll continue...

speaker: Jairo
en: (saying loudly) Wait a moment!

speaker: Jairo
cn: （小声）你给Julián打个电话，跟他要啊！他是个富二代，才三十万美元肯定能给你！
en: (whispering) Call Julián and ask him for it! He comes from money. It’s only three hundred grand—he can definitely afford it!

speaker: Eloísa
en: (Happy) Exactly! Go find Julián—he'll definitely give me something.

speaker: Julián(OS)
en: (impatiently) Eloísa? What do you want?

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （撒娇）Julián哥哥，你能借三十万美元吗？我家里遇到点事。
en: (acting cute) Honey, could you lend me three hundred grand? Something bad happened to my family.

speaker: Julián
cn: 三十万美元？你开玩笑吧，没有！
en: Three hundred grand? You crazy? Fuck off!

speaker: Jairo
en: How's it going? What did Julián say?

speaker: Damián(VO)
en: This is amazing! So fucking good!
